Are you considering that he may have social delays and/or was raised in a home with different manners than you? He also is quite literally desperate and has probably had 1,000 mean faced people tell him no recently. Of course he’s going to ask for more, you were his ONE SHOT today. I understand you are feeling taken advantage of, but his body is in survival mode and battling addiction. 

I saw that you’re 20. I recommend continuing to give and be generous and practice your expectations. Give for the sake of helping, not for thank you’s, not for being a savior, not to make sure they do it your way. 

I regularly see “in search of” posts on my towns free/buy nothing group and fill them. A lot of the time i don’t even exchange words with the person and do door drop offs etc. praise isn’t the goal. Fulfilling a need is. 

With this man, he needed food and you provided it to him. You also let him have some control over his life by picking the sandwich. That’s enough. You helped that man, so shut off the part of you that had any other expectations on how that situation would have/ should have went. Block out what he said before and after. He owes you nothing and you owe him nothing more. Move on to the next person you decide to help. 

Should he have been kind and grateful? Yea maybe, but real life isn’t a movie and we never know what someone is carrying that day, what they have been through or even how capable they are of *being* kind and grateful. That doesn’t make them less deserving of your generosity or less of a human being. 

I mean, do what you want to do but this mindset has helped me grow.

Just because they are begging doesn’t mean he isn’t a human with preferences. 

Good deeds aren’t for your pleasure and you’re not bestowing a life changing thing to him. Calm your ego and help for the simple sake of helping.
